semantic_fidelity.reason: All 13 reference entities and 14 directed line geometries occur across views, but e6 UDP ownership is visually ambiguous, the view-2 router is unqualified, no committed rate and source identifiers are absent, and the IPv6 note is presented as an unattached device-like node. Coverage ledgers and deliberate-drop reasons cannot substitute for visible required meaning.

arrow_traceability.reason: All 14 actual independent arrow geometries are traceable stem-to-unique intact downward arrowhead, with correct directed endpoints, zero crossings/bridges/shared cells/inline forks. Source-named buses are not required here. One adjacent bend pair and staggered runs remain distinguishable. e6 fails semantic/protocol ownership, not geometric endpoint trace. No animated dot compromises origin/direction.

layout_fit.reason: All graph boxes/full labels are physically visible at app-reported 77x47 natural 100%; graph clipping=0 and crossings=0. Viewer-help truncation is UI furniture, not a failed graph-fit label. Nevertheless the saved attempt choice deletes required claimed qualification to reduce a crossing (F6), contrary to complete source coverage and no meaning-for-layout trade. Separately, independent measured live width/rectangle is missing (G1); this gap cannot erase the known layout-selection failure.

conceptual_grouping_color.reason: Normal ANSI shows coherent nearby source concepts: guest/bridge nodes share amber shades, homelab host teal, physical uplinks pink, local edge amber within the WAN view, ISP hops teal, and destination a separate family. The placement follows virtual-to-host, overlay/host-to-uplinks-to-gateway, and historical WAN order. No alphabetic/depth grouping or source-tier reordering is evidenced. Per-view palette reuse/hue changes are not a separate gate; the IPv6 caption-role problem is classified semantic.

border_integrity.reason: Normal and selected ANSI prove all four sides/corners and uniform RGB per perimeter for all 16 node occurrences (5+6+5). Selected perimeters are all bold RGB (216,166,87), including the note. Coverage=16/16 in simultaneous all-selected snapshots. These do not prove isolated interaction transitions or drag-handle states; no such separate state is requested/present and no handle defect appears.

workflow_evidence.reason: Frozen input, binary, spec/attempt/artifact and harness hashes match; separate DeepSeek generator and actual Sol judge identities, immutable blind-first record, exact harness/viewer commands, combined check stdout/stderr with exit/windows, normal/selected ANSI and text/frame evidence, and all three cleanup probes are preserved. But separately measured live pane columns/rectangle are absent in all manifests. This required evidence gap blocks a workflow pass despite the validator green results. Corrected rubric identity revision 4 is recorded without falsifying reviewer identity.

animation.reason: Source requests a layout, not animation; frozen cases.json and expected.json mark homelab animation optional, and generator chose static. All 15 supplied 0–400 ms frames have zero route dots and no motion. Full-cycle direction/origin/synchronized-arrival tests are N/A, not inferred from five-frame samples; header middle dots are static separators.

findings.description: DEFECT: UDP encap at [17,11,9,1] abuts the column-16 tailscale-to-host line. Its intended tailscale-to-bond0 bypass is at column 14, separated from the text by the other line. Thus the required UDP-on-wired relation is semantically ambiguous and an extra UDP-on-overlay/host association is apparent. JSON ownership and clean label-cell checks do not repair the capture. One uncertain label owner, as recorded blind.

DEFECT: View 2 names Fios rtr 192.168.1.1 without claimed/historical qualification. View 3 does qualify the same address, but that does not qualify the independently readable local-uplinks view. Source explicitly requires qualification of MAC-vendor router identity; a required qualifier was removed to avoid a crossing, per attempts.json. The ONT and downstream interpretations are correctly qualified in view 3.

DEFECT: No committed rate, a source-stated property of this host's Fios egress and a Part B answer, is absent from every final view. Recording a deliberate drop or exhausted attempt budget is not complete source coverage. NAT/pool IP and the IPv6 limitation are present, so this is a specific missing egress qualifier, not an absent whole WAN view.

DEFECT: Identifier audit finds source LAN prefix 192.168.1.0/24, host software identifier Linux 7.0, and WNC OUI provenance absent from all final captures. The bond0 and Wi-Fi individual IPv4 addresses are complete, but do not explicitly give the LAN prefix. claimed in view 3 expresses uncertainty, not the missing WNC provenance. These are localized source-label omissions; no required IPv4 host/interface address or AS number is lost. Supporting generation prose is not a rendered key.

DEFECT: The source limitation no global v6 (ULA only) is preserved as text but drawn in the same complete selectable device-style box as actual interfaces/devices. It has no edge or explicit attachment to homelab. Its words read as a note, yet the graph grammar presents an isolated peer entity. This is a localized role/scope ambiguity, not an invented directed relation. Native annotation support is only reported missing by the generator; that claim is not treated as a proven impossibility.

DEFECT: The selected zero-crossing view 2 drops claimed from the router label. The saved attempt ledger explicitly trades the qualifier for reducing one crossing to zero. Layout may not recover fit/readability by weakening required meaning or losing source coverage. No group reordering or relation merging is visible, and no graph box is physically clipped; the failure is the documented meaning-for-layout trade, not the three truncated viewer-help tails.

EVIDENCE GAP / BLOCKER: Every manifest has pane_cols=null and pane_rect=null; pane_rows=47 is recorded. App headers, 77-cell ANSI rows and runtime viewport: 77x47 zoom: 1.00 natural establish the app grid, but no independently recorded live pane width/rectangle survives. generation.json.measured.columns=77 repeats a claim without a raw external-width result. The fixed fit/workflow gates require separately measured live dimensions. All three checks, artifact hashes and cleanup probes are otherwise preserved.

blockers: G1 — Missing separately measured live pane columns and rectangle in all three manifests; record live_pane=null. App viewport is verified from actual grids/runtime lines but cannot substitute for the separately required external pane measurement. No new viewer session is permitted to repair this record. No model-unavailability blocker; native annotation support is a reported capability gap, not an independently proven impossibility.

cleanup.reason: Each case manifest records confirmed_closed; pinned capture harness implements close followed by failing herdr pane get, and generation records all three closures in the generator-owned tab w7E:t3S.
